VoiceUP RNNoise component
=========================

The bundled microphone noise suppressor uses the following open-source
projects. Processing runs locally inside VoiceUP; these components do not
upload microphone audio or contact an external service.

RNNoise
  Copyright Jean-Marc Valin, Amazon, Mozilla, Xiph.Org Foundation and
  contributors. Distributed under the BSD 3-Clause license.
  Source: https://github.com/xiph/rnnoise
  License: LICENSE-rnnoise.txt

@sapphi-red/web-noise-suppressor 0.4.0
  Copyright sapphi-red. Distributed under the MIT license.
  Source: https://github.com/sapphi-red/web-noise-suppressor
  License: LICENSE-web-noise-suppressor.txt

@shiguredo/rnnoise-wasm 2022.2.0
  Distributed under the Apache License 2.0.
  Source: https://github.com/shiguredo/rnnoise-wasm
  License: LICENSE-shiguredo-rnnoise-wasm.txt

The worklet was copied from the published
@sapphi-red/web-noise-suppressor 0.4.0 package and renamed from
workletProcessor.js to rnnoise-worklet.js. The WASM binaries were copied
from the same published package without modification.
